_README: Curator pins of the area a drink GI is drawn from — see scripts/_lib/drinks/geometry.py. Keyed by record slug. `units`: `country:XX` (the whole country), `nuts:CODE` (a GISCO NUTS 2024 unit of any level), `lau:XX:Name[@NUTS]` (a GISCO LAU 2024 municipality by its layer name, inside the NUTS unit after @ when the name is not unique) `lauid:XX:PREFIX=Label` (every LAU row whose GISCO id starts with the prefix — a Greek δήμος or δημοτική ενότητα, a Portuguese município — under the label the card shows), `minus:<unit>` (cut out of the union of the others) `uk:country:Name` / `uk:county:Name[=Label]` (an ONS country or county / unitary authority of the United Kingdom) or `ref:slug` (the polygon of another record — the wine appellation the drink shares its delimitation with). `quote` is the sentence of the record's own area text that names the units, verbatim (tests/test_drinks_areas.py checks it against the extracted record, whitespace folded); `note` is the curator's remark on the reading; `disclose` (en / fr / es / nl) is the sentence the card adds where the drawing departs from the letter — a part of a municipality drawn as the municipality, an island as its NUTS unit, a named unit left out; `largest_part` keeps the largest polygon of the union (an island without the islets its parishes also hold); `region` overrides the sidebar region. `verified` is the date the text was read. A record whose text names units no layer carries (a parish, a radius, a boundary traced in prose) has no pin and is not drawn: scripts/audit_drinks_coverage.py lists it.
